verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents daily continuous monitoring with proactive email alerts to admins when tests fail (docs-30, docs-12), plus drift detection for managed Azure Government resources where admins review, retain, or revert discrepancies (docs-56). It also offers auto-generated infrastructure-as-code fixes that support remediation (docs-28). Slack and Jira/ticketing delivery is only evidenced for vendor-risk and access-review tasks, not for control-test failures, and nothing shows the alerts themselves carry remediation context. Missing for 10: Slack or ticketing delivery of failing-test and drift alerts, evidence that alerts include remediation context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
